requirements.title: NEW_LINE result is length-one character with A kind
requirements.definition: The NEW_LINE result is a character scalar of length one with the same kind type parameter as A.

pending.NEW_LINE-result-character-scalar: Assign NEW_LINE(A) to a scalar character variable initialized to a distinctive sentinel and assert scalar assignment succeeds with LEN 1. Mutate the call to an array-valued character expression so the scalar control fails source review.
pending.NEW_LINE-result-length-one: Assert LEN(NEW_LINE('abc')) == 1 with a companion LEN(A)==3 check so length one is not inherited from the argument. Mutate the intrinsic to return A in a wrapper so the length check fails.
pending.NEW_LINE-result-same-kind-as-A: Use default character and a guarded selected ASCII character kind; assert KIND(NEW_LINE(A)) equals KIND(A). Mutate A kind so the kind check fails.

requirements.title: NEW_LINE ASCII or ISO 10646 character case
